CustomField.description: used to trigger a workflow when the case owner changes from the NCSP Assignment Queue to an NCSP CSA
CustomField.formula: IF( OwnerId = '00G800000022m9f', "Assignment Queue", IF(BEGINS (OwnerId, "00G") && (OwnerId <> '00G800000022m9f') , "Queue", IF(CONTAINS($Label.NCSP_Owner, OwnerId ) , "NCSP CSA", "User")))
CustomField.label: NCSP Owner
